benefits.text:
hince Mirror Dew Gloss is a lip gloss that creates mirror-like radiance with a plump, mirror-like shine, helping lips look fuller, smoother and more radiant as soon as it is applied. The gloss texture glides on smoothly in a single stroke and sits comfortably on the lips without an uncomfortable sticky feel. The formula contains 93%+ moisturizing essence ingredients along with 6-Peptide Complex, Ceramide NP, Panthenol and Jojoba Seed Oil, helping lips stay moist and silky, with a healthy-looking shine and a smoother finish within your makeup. The color shows up clearly, creating a high-density coloring effect while staying clear and fresh; suitable to wear on its own or layered with other hince lip products.
1. The mirror dew glow effect helps lips look plump, glossy, juicy and more radiant.
2. The gloss texture glides on smoothly, sits comfortably on the lips and minimises an uncomfortable sticky feel.
3. The formula contains 93%+ moisturizing essence ingredients, helping lips stay soft and smooth, with a healthy-looking shine within your makeup.

The 2026 Chill Voyage Collection adds 2 new shades to the nude gloss range, with a soft shimmer like sunlight on sand: 09 Sand Kiss and 10 Sand Pink. Shade 09 Sand Kiss is a warm sand coral with subtle sandy gold and silver shimmer, suited to warm nude makeup, a sandy rose look or summer looks that call for warm, soft nude lips that softly catch the light. Shade 10 Sand Pink is a cool nude pink with subtle blue and silver shimmer, suited to cool-tone makeup, a clean blue look or looks that call for clear, lightly cool nude pink lips that are more distinctive than a basic pink gloss.

safety.text:
For external use on the lip area only; do not use on damaged lips,
Stop use if any unusual signs appear and keep out of reach of children.

howToUse.text: Use the wide curved side of the applicator tip to apply the gloss evenly over the whole lips. Use the narrow tip to outline and refine the edges of the lips for a sharper look. You can apply one layer for a natural shine, or layer more to build up the plump glossy effect and color.

positioning.text: A high-shine lip gloss that creates a plump, mirror-like glossy lip effect, combining clear color, a smooth gliding feel and moisture in one product.

sellingPoints.text: Plump, mirror-like shine with the Maximal Mirror Glow effect; Glides on smoothly, sits comfortably and doesn't feel uncomfortably sticky; 93%+ moisturizing essence ingredients and 24-hour hydration & glow wear test completed

texture.text: Moist, shiny gloss that glides smoothly, thin and light, not uncomfortably sticky.

finish.text: Mirror dew glow / sheer apricot beige / clear shine.

claimDisclaimers.text: The 24-hour hydration/glow wear test and 100% user satisfaction survey claims are based on the brand's test/survey with 20 participants. The primary skin irritation and sensitive skin tests are recorded as tested with shade 02 KIND. Do not interpret these as absolute results for every natural lip color or every condition of use.
